module: Node "Get Project Info" (once_instant, event_note icon). Gives information about the current flowgraph project. Outputs: name, description, flow, and hidden pins id, hasFilename, filename (without .flow.json), filepath, hasLevel, level (level whose folder contains the project), graph, graphId.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: Reads mgr.id/name/description, savedFilename/savedDir (via path.splitWithoutExt, path.levelFromPath) and the current graph, then writes the pins and activates flow.
